I solved level 1 of task-0b529a18 in 12 actions. The human baseline is 22, so my cost is below baseline.

How the game works:
- A chain has two ends and a ball. The ball always sits at the midpoint between the ends.
- The end colored 3 is the anchor. The end colored 0 moves to the empty cell you click.
- Clicking the anchor end swaps the roles of the two ends. Clicking the free end does not swap them. My first try to swap that way failed.
- You win when the ball is on the diamond target. To do this, put the ends at equal distances on opposite sides of the target, and swap the anchor between the two moves.

I saved these rules as a global memory for later levels and games. The first two save calls failed on wrong arguments.
